alerts.headline: Daily Voice: RBI unlikely to hike rates by more than 100 bps in current cycle, says Sushant Bhansali
alerts.summary: According to Sushant Bhansali of Ambit Asset Management, the earnings growth trajectory of Indian corporates is unlikely to be meaningfully impacted, given his expectation of only moderate rate hikes during this cycle.

alerts.headline: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
